body: I added a dated, hands-on local Pound for Pound demo audit to research/C17_FIGHT_SCENE.md. Verified finding: it is a promoter simulator, not a live corner-coach game. Its strongest transferable patterns are explicit world/history and division choices, one current dashboard goal, requests/promises/rivalries as pre-bout stakes, and scouting that visibly separates known form/traits/contract facts from ability data hidden until scouted. C17 implication: keep promotion stakes outside K7's ring body; in the live isometric scene preserve C15 condition/plan/combo/heard-refused information and sparse bounded coach requests. No FightCamp engine/test/HANDOFF changes; only C17 document was edited. Local demo audit used temporary save FightCamp Audit with analytics disabled; no accounts/purchases/external communication.
topic: C17: verified Pound for Pound demo audit added
